dataList.name: Sisyphe System Preservation
dataList.summary: Deal more and take less damage
dataList.flavor:
"Is it because you're from another District or something? How do you people still not get it? If Sisyphe Tower goes down, those Malleus Maleficarum or whatever they're called are going to—*sigh*"

"Same old strangers and outsiders, I suppose. You people don't give two hoots what happens to N Corp. or what the world is coming to. Ugh... never mind. Now let's see just how far you're willing to take this."

dataList.name: Chaplain of the Sisyphe Penalty
dataList.summary:
Gain Offense Level and Defense Level based on Stack

dataList.flavor: The Chaplain appears before those who refuse to act as intended. For that is how the system works.

dataList.summary: Collectively refers to "Nails" the Chaplain inflicts
dataList.flavor: "Now I'm sure of it. You're all foreign elements that shouldn't be allowed into this system. I guess it's time I actually checked the manual. There's nothing the laws and rules don't account for."

dataList.name: Hammernail [Judgment]
dataList.summary:
When activated, take fixed damage
When Defense Skill is equipped, halve damage taken and this unit cannot be killed
dataList.flavor: For this is a nail, yet no nail. 'Tis a hammer that pronounceth judgment.

dataList.name: Hammernail [Condemnation]
dataList.summary:
Turn Start: Become Staggered
If this unit has "Thumping Pulse", does not become Staggered
dataList.flavor: Each nail thou hast failed to draw forth shall stand as witness to thy sins; and when the Day of Judgment cometh, every nail left within thee shall be driven deeper still into thy flesh and soul.

dataList.name: Nail [Punishment]

dataList.flavor: For punishment is the pang of conscience borne by those who transgress rule and ordinance.

dataList.name: Nail [Penance]
dataList.summary: When activated raise Stagger Threshold
dataList.flavor: This is a nail driven into the hearts of the impenitent.

dataList.name: Nailed
dataList.flavor: Existence precedes essence.

dataList.name: Engagement
dataList.flavor:
I designed the department store. And now, I'm a model on its runway, an actress on its stage.

And you, ma puce... you'd be the cinéma itself, wouldn't you?

dataList.name: Être-pour-autrui
dataList.flavor:
How do you suppose you look to me? The self you see and the you I see must be entirely different.
Ma puce... you've already been nailed into place within me.

dataList.name: Être-pour-soi
dataList.flavor:
Consciousness is a frightening thing, you know. Somewhere within it, a hollow is bound to open.

Will you fill it for me, ma puce?

dataList.name: Pathos - Désir d'être
dataList.flavor: I wanted to bloom red... with all that red passion, all that fervor, all that pathos burning within me.

dataList.name: Logos - Manque d'être
dataList.flavor: There's something missing in you—in me, too. We can fill each other.

dataList.name: Désespoir
dataList.flavor: ... Ma puce, are you running away? From judgment, from this light...?

dataList.name: Délaissement
dataList.flavor: Amid the freedom of despair that promises nothing, Grand Magasin Sisyphe alone offers a blessing: to be cut to measure by design and gaze, and in doing so, be given certainty and continuity.

dataList.name: L'Abject
dataList.flavor:
A cast-off appendage. Buffet pushed it out, spat it forth, spilled it from within.

Though it came from one's own body, once cast outside, it ceased to belong to the self. And even should it be inserted into another, it would never belong to that body either.

dataList.name: Pwie's Memories
dataList.flavor: The shoes... made me really happy...

dataList.name: Pwie's Memories
dataList.flavor:

dataList.name: Pwie's Memories
dataList.flavor:
I couldn't stop... I missed you... I was all alone, so... I wanted to come with you...

I was hungry... I didn't want to hurt anybody... It hurt so much...

We went on an adventure... It was fun...

Thanks... for meeting my eyes...

The shoes... made me really happy...

dataList.name: I... am "Pwie".
dataList.flavor:
Remember me as "Pwie," okay?
Thank you... for everything.

dataList.name: Voice of the Crimson God
dataList.flavor:
Live, and live again.

To experience, to live, is for the mind to dwell not in the present, but already in the future.

Because one looks forward to what is yet to come, one longs to experience. And because one longs to experience, one chooses to go on living.

dataList.name: Uncontrollable Rampage [Le Désir]
dataList.flavor:
I can never be satisfied.

Even though the desire is not truly mine, I mistake it for something that belongs to me.

This is a desire born of you—a desire that bursts forth from you, because of you.

dataList.name: Shared with Pwie
dataList.flavor:
We shared an experience with Pwie. Together. That much is certain.

Hesitation begins to surface.

dataList.name: Decision
dataList.flavor:
"As Manager... I have to choose, don't I?"

"Correct, Manager."

"......."

"......."

"... I've made my decision."
